scope: Review and repair the newly reported Zod and fast-uri dependency findings during the authorized content-maintenance update.

advisories.summary: Oversized invalid collections can cause excessive validation issue allocation and memory exhaustion.

Host confusion through unchecked WHATWG host canonicalization.
